note: Triennial rural district council election. Polling in Fermanagh took place on Wednesday 3 June 1936 and the results were declared on Thursday 4 June. The Monea division was the only contest in this district. The other twenty-five divisions were filled unopposed at the nominations; their members are named in the Impartial Reporter of 7 May 1936, p. 7 (added 6 Nov 2026). Filed on 1936-06-03, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Fermanagh that year (provisional); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Oldbarr' to Old Barr (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Enniskillen Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Old Barr; the rounds were filed as Oldbar (1927, 1933, 1955, 1964); Oldbarr (1930, 1936, 1939, 1946); Old Barr (1949, 1952). This round was filed as 'Oldbarr', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (oldbarr) answers with a redirect to this one.
